# VOCCSYS — Vulcan Online Condenser Cleaning System

> VOCCSYS is a patented online condenser tube cleaning system engineered and manufactured by Vulcan Industries India. It uses a closed loop of soft sponge balls circulating with the cooling water to continuously scrub scale and biofilm from the internal surfaces of condenser tubes — while the plant remains in operation. No shutdown, no chemicals, measurable recovery in heat rate and fuel cost.

## What VOCCSYS does
- Cleans condenser tubes online, 24×7, without stopping the plant.
- Continuously restores heat rate by keeping internal tube surfaces free of scale, biofilm and micro-fouling.
- Eliminates the need for offline (mechanical, brush or chemical) cleaning cycles.
- Retrofit-ready — installs on existing condensers with minimal piping modifications.

## Core outcomes (typical)
- **Heat rate recovery:** 1–3% at the turbine, continuously.
- **Payback period:** Under 12 months for most large condensers, from fuel savings alone.
- **Shutdown required:** Zero — the plant runs uninterrupted.
- **Fouling loss reduction:** 40–60% vs. offline cleaning cycles.
- **Chemical usage:** None. Fully mechanical.

## How it works — 4-stage closed loop
1. **Inject** — Sponge balls (slightly oversized vs tube ID) are injected into the cooling water inlet header via the VOCCSYS ball trap.
2. **Scrub** — Balls flow through every condenser tube with the water, wiping the internal surface clean of scale and biofilm on every pass.
3. **Collect** — A downstream strainer captures 100% of the balls after the condenser without disturbing water flow.
4. **Recirculate** — The recovery pump re-injects the collected balls back to the inlet, forming a closed, continuous cleaning loop.

## Technical specifications (representative)
- **Models:** VCS-500 / VCS-1000 / VCS-2000 / custom
- **Tube ID compatibility:** 18 mm to 32 mm
- **Tube materials supported:** SS 304 / 316L, Titanium, Cu-Ni, Admiralty Brass
- **Sponge balls:** Natural rubber / EPDM foam; standard, abrasive and extra-abrasive grades; typical life 1,500–3,000 hours per lot.
- **Ball recovery:** 100% via mesh strainer / basket-type collector.
- **Control:** PLC + HMI, SCADA-ready. Sensors for differential pressure, flow, turbidity and ball count.
- **Piping:** MS / SS with rubber lining; ANSI B16.5 flanges.
- **Power supply:** 415 V, 3φ, 50 Hz (customisable).
- **Design code alignment:** TEMA / HEI.
- **Warranty:** 12 months from commissioning.

## Industries served
- Thermal & Nuclear Power Generation (main and auxiliary condensers, closed-cycle cooling)
- HVAC & District Cooling (large chiller condensers)
- Petrochemical & Refining (overhead condensers and heat exchangers)
- Steel & Metals (blast furnace, rolling mill, continuous casting cooling)
- Sugar & Paper (vapour condensers, process heat exchangers)
- Chemical & Fertilizer (process condensers with challenging water chemistry)

## Frequently asked
- **Does VOCCSYS require plant shutdown?** No. It runs online with the plant in service.
- **Does VOCCSYS use chemicals?** No. Purely mechanical cleaning using sponge balls.
- **What is the payback period?** Typically under 12 months from fuel savings alone.
- **Can VOCCSYS be retrofitted?** Yes. Designed for retrofit on existing condensers.
- **What tube materials does it support?** SS 304 / 316L, Titanium, Cu-Ni, Admiralty Brass, and more.
- **What is the heat rate improvement?** Typically 1–3% continuous recovery at the turbine.
